There’s the time.
And then there’s
your time.

Dhi’s Clock is a personalised timepiece that offers guidance based on your birthday. It introduces a different way to approach life’s changing cycles, from starting something new to knowing when to step back.

Your day.

A daily prompt to consider what to begin, pursue, complete or pause.

Your month.

A wider view of the themes and opportunities that may shape your month.

Your year.

A longer perspective on changing cycles, with your birthday at its centre.

Personalised on Amazon. Your date of birth makes the guidance yours.

How the clock works.

Dhi’s Clock brings birthday-based guidance into a daily routine: check your personal day, month and year, then read the corresponding prompts on the clock face.

Make it yours.

Your date of birth is the starting point for the clock’s personalised number cycles.

Read your time.

The display brings together your day, month and year. Match its numbers to the guidance printed around the dial.

Take a moment.

Use the prompts as a moment for personal reflection before a call, a study session or the working day.

A moment to pause.
A way to move forward.

Before the day takes over, check in with your time. Dhi’s Clock brings daily, monthly and yearly guidance into one familiar place: a clock on your wall.

A little more
clarity.

What makes the clock personal?

Dhi’s Clock uses your birthday as the basis for its daily, monthly and yearly guidance. The prompts explore when to act, pursue, begin, complete or step back.

How do I order my clock?

Follow the Amazon link to view the product and provide the personalisation details requested there. Amazon handles checkout. Check the listing for current pricing, delivery and availability.

Where can I see more?

Watch the videos on this website or visit Dhi’s Clock on YouTube for more information about the clock.

Can I ask a question before buying?

Of course. Write to dhisclock@dauji.net with your question about the clock or Dhi’s work. You can also call +91 88820 88750.
